astrology.placeholder: Genre-based inspiration generation and setting-expansion capabilities will be integrated here later.
astrology.title: Astrology inspiration
help.faq.knowledgeRequired.answer: Not required. First use the auto director to advance a book to a writable state; when you need reference material, book-breakdown results, or long-term settings, then use the knowledge base.
help.faq.knowledgeRequired.question: Is the knowledge base required?
help.faq.needOutline.answer: No. On your first use, just enter a single spark of inspiration, let the AI auto director give a whole-book direction first, then confirm step by step.
help.faq.needOutline.question: Do I need to know how to write an outline?
help.faq.qualityPending.answer: It means the system first records ordinary quality issues, prioritizes finishing the whole book, and later fixes these chapters in a batch.
help.faq.qualityPending.question: What does "quality pending recovery" mean?
help.faq.taskFailed.answer: First go to the task center to check the failure reason. After handling common model, network, or authorization issues, you can return to the original project and continue.
help.faq.taskFailed.question: What should I do when a task fails?
help.faqSection.description: When something is uncertain, look at these judgments first.
help.faqSection.title: FAQ
help.goal.adjustStyle.description: Distill the text styles you like into writing-style assets, then bind them to a novel for ongoing reuse.
help.goal.adjustStyle.title: Adjust writing style
help.goal.configureVendor.description: Fill in the vendor interface, API Key, and default model to ensure the writing pipeline has an available model.
help.goal.configureVendor.title: Configure model vendor
help.goal.continueProject.description: Go back to the novel list, choose the book most worth continuing, and then finish planning or chapter writing.
help.goal.continueProject.title: Continue a project
help.goal.directorFollowUp.description: Centrally handle the quality-recovery items left by the auto director, so the whole book keeps advancing toward completion.
help.goal.directorFollowUp.title: Director follow-up
help.goal.fromScratch.description: Good for when you have only one idea and haven't yet thought through the genre, selling points, protagonist, and early plot.
help.goal.fromScratch.title: Start a book from scratch
help.goal.handleTasks.description: Check background running, queued, and failed tasks, and prioritize issues that affect continued writing.
help.goal.handleTasks.title: Handle tasks
help.goalSection.description: You don't need to understand every feature first; choose an entry by what you want to accomplish.
help.goalSection.title: Choose an entry by goal
help.guide.advanceToWritable.description: Let AI keep preparing the story's main line, characters, volume strategy, and chapter breakdown, until the project is ready for chapter execution.
help.guide.advanceToWritable.title: Advance to writable
help.guide.autoDirector.description: The system generates the whole-book direction, a set of titles, and book-opening preparation, breaking complex planning into steps you can confirm.
help.guide.autoDirector.title: Let AI auto-direct the book opening
help.guide.configureModel.description: First configure the model vendor, API Key, and default model in system settings, so auto director and chapter execution can run smoothly afterward.
help.guide.configureModel.title: Configure model
help.guide.confirmDirection.description: Choose the set you most want to write from the candidates; if you're not satisfied, you can keep generating or adjust only the selected option.
help.guide.confirmDirection.title: Confirm the direction
help.guide.enterChapterExecution.descrip: Write, review, and fix chapter by chapter; when you want to speed up, you can let the whole-book production task keep advancing.
help.guide.enterChapterExecution.title: Enter chapter execution
help.guide.inputInspiration.description: You can write just a genre, protagonist, conflict, or even a vague idea; AI will first help organize it into a workable book direction.
help.guide.inputInspiration.title: Enter a spark of inspiration
help.guide.viewTasks.description: The task center handles failures, queuing, and running status; the director follow-up page centrally handles quality items that need recovery.
help.guide.viewTasks.title: View tasks and follow-ups
help.hero.subtitle: Follow this route and you don't need to write an outline, character sheet, or volume plan first. You only provide ideas and make key choices, and AI breaks the whole book into steps you can keep advancing.
help.hero.title: Start from a single spark of inspiration and let AI guide you through your first novel
help.modelCard.description: Auto director, main-text writing, and chapter review all need an available model. Finish configuring the model vendor, API Key, and default model first, then starting the book-opening flow will go more smoothly.
help.modelCard.title: Configure a model before you start writing
help.recommended.description: On your first use, follow this route and you can move from an idea to writable chapters.
help.recommended.title: Recommended route
